about: The collecta of the formulary “Blessed Virgin Mary of the Rosary” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Whose only-begotten Son, by His life, death and resurrection, has purchased for us the rewards of eternal salvation, grant, we beseech You, that, meditating on these mysteries in the most holy Rosary of the Blessed Virgin Mary, we may imitate what they contain and obtain what they promise. Through the same Jesus Christ, our Lord, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.
